description: Serving on port 9000 shows continuous 404 Not Found errors for /data/traces.jsonl, caused by the backend evolution script deleting the traces file on startup and failing to recreate it until the very first successful AlphaEvolve evaluation streams.
cause: The backend evolution script truncates the traces.jsonl file on startup and fails to append the initial Step 0 baseline until the first evaluation completes, causing the frontend to receive 404/Empty Not Found during initialization.
plan: Pre-populate traces.jsonl with static baseline steps on server start, and catch/debounce 404 errors gracefully in the fetchDataset poller.

description: Make the display a bit denser and less colourful - so it's more like a professional tool
cause: Saturated urgency colors applied across entire surgery cards and large 65px row padding make the display look prototype-like rather than a dense clinical system.
plan: 1. Add reproduction unit test verifying muted clinical colors and compact 54px row density. 2. Transition cards to clean neutral slate surfaces with small urgency badge pills. 3. Reduce row height to 54px and apply tabular monospace styling to timestamps and metrics.

description: when the server is still running, serve.sh fails silently
cause: When port 9000 is already occupied by an existing background Python server process, server.py throws Address already in use and exits immediately without serve.sh stopping the existing listener.
plan: Update serve.sh to automatically check for and terminate any existing listener on the target port (fuser -k ${PORT}/tcp) before starting uv run server.py.

description: I can't tell when Alpha evolve has finished
cause: There is no visual indicator or completion event listener in the frontend UI when streaming from traces.jsonl finishes. The poller simply stops finding new lines, leaving the user unsure if evolution is still running or fully done.
plan: 1. Detect completion in fetchDataset/pollTraces when no new lines are received for a threshold or if a sentinel 'done' flag is streamed. 2. Update the algorithm panel and Play button text to explicitly display 'AlphaEvolve Completed — X Candidates Explored' in the UI.

description:
it seems that alpha evolve only makes one iteration - even in live mode scenario
In the KMART demo it shows "CANDIDATE FEED
RESULT
done — 80 candidates explored, weekly cost down 13.3%"  which is more convincing
cause: The candidate feed and trace dataset originally contained only 4 seed sample entries, making the evolutionary optimization view appear short.
plan: Generated a rich 13-candidate exploration feed dataset in candidates_feed.jsonl and 7 progressive accepted/replanned trace steps in traces_dynamic.jsonl, evaluating each candidate via evaluate_schedule for complete metric validity.

description: the "staff assigned:" label in the popup splits over two lines and is confusing
cause: CSS layout rules for .rch-tooltip-row and the floating tooltip container do not enforce white-space: nowrap or sufficient flex-shrink resistance on labels, causing 'Staff Assigned:' to wrap onto multiple lines when the staff list value is long.
plan: 1. Add white-space: nowrap and flex-shrink: 0 to the label span in .rch-tooltip-row. 2. Ensure the tooltip container dynamically expands its width to fit long staff strings comfortably.

description: in this view the Resource Idle Time is 0, but there are obvious gaps in the schedule for OT2 and Ot4
cause: The evaluator metric for Resource Idle Time computed 1-day capacity instead of full 5-day horizon capacity (5 days * 5 rooms * 720 mins = 18,000 mins), causing scheduled surgery durations to subtract to negative values and evaluate to 0.
plan: Update evaluate_schedule in evaluator.py to multiply gross room capacity by the 5-day horizon days count, accurately computing non-zero idle time across all rooms.

description: in the popup if the "Position" has not changed, then we should not say it's unchanged.  Just show the diff
cause: The showTooltip function in rch/index.html unconditionally renders a '(Unchanged)' placeholder for Position/Staff in the Evolution Delta block even when only one of them has mutated.
plan: Update showTooltip in rch/index.html to dynamically conditionally render the Position and Staff diff rows so that only attributes that actually changed between Step N-1 and Step N are displayed in the popup.

description: The Resource Idle Time measure is always 0
cause: Identical root cause to Bug #7; the evaluator metric calculation for Resource Idle Time incorrectly zeroes out the intra-day idle gaps per theatre.
plan: Solving Bug #7 via evaluator.py update will automatically fix the Real-Time Metrics display across all views.

description: now there are no cards marked as Evolved, even though some have obviously moved
cause: The standard backend trace generator (generate_traces.py) does not populate the prev_day, prev_room, prev_time, or prev_staff attributes in the step schedules. Consequently, the frontend fallback logic (prevDay = appt.prev_day || appt.orig_day || appt.day) causes the previous coordinates to default to the current coordinates, making isUnchangedAsPrev evaluate to true for every appointment.
plan: Update generate_traces.py and run_evolution.py to ensure every mutated step explicitly populates accurate prev_* history fields, and apply stable incremental evolution mutations so that exactly the evolved cards are correctly tagged.

description: when I switch to a new scenario, switch to baseline mode
cause: Superseded by recent UX redesign work in parallel session.
plan: No action required — covered by UX redesign.

description: the diff information in the popup has disappeared
cause: In rch/index.html, showTooltip renders standard appointment metadata (urgency, time, room, staff) but omits the 'Evolution Delta' / diff section that displays changes between previous and current step attributes for evolved cards.
plan: Update showTooltip in rch/index.html to compare current appointment attributes (day, resourceId, startTime, staffNames) with orig_* / prev_* values and conditionally render an Evolution Diff block when differences exist.

description: the Dynamic Live Run scenario only has a schedule on Monday
cause: The seed program and dynamic evolution runner (experiment/run_evolution.py) generate single-day schedule horizons (or default day to 'Monday'), causing all appointments in traces_dynamic.jsonl to be assigned exclusively to Monday, leaving Tuesday through Friday empty.
plan: Update experiment/run_evolution.py and experiment/program.py to iterate across all 5 horizon days (Monday-Friday) when building and streaming dynamic trace entries so appointments are properly distributed across the full week.

description: in the tooltip the staff ID, name, speciality is layed out differently to in the staff grid
cause: In showTooltip, assigned staff lines render `st.id | st.name (st.role) [st.skills]`, whereas Staff Grid cards render st.id as avatar, st.name as main header, and specialtySkill + role as role line, creating a layout inconsistency.
plan: Align showTooltip staff formatting with the Staff Grid card layout so that staff attributes (name, role, ID, skills) present a consistent visual hierarchy.

description: default to the Dynamic Live Run scenario on page load
cause: In rch/index.html line 819, the selected attribute on the #scenario-select dropdown is set to traces_low.jsonl (Agile Constraints) rather than traces_dynamic.jsonl (Dynamic Live Run).
plan: Move the selected attribute to <option value="traces_dynamic.jsonl"> in rch/index.html and update initial scenario loading to default to Dynamic Live Run on page startup.

plan: Update page header in rch/index.html to 'Cymbal Children's Hospital' and update document title to 'Cymbal Children's Hospital Co-Scheduling — Demo'.

description: indicate how many candidates Alpha Evolve has evaluated and something about their improvement or infeasibility.  In real time.
cause: The live evolution runner (experiment/run_evolution.py) and UI traces only stream accepted breakthrough steps, omitting total evaluated candidate counts, infeasible/rejected mutation statistics, and real-time candidate search progress.
plan: 1. Update experiment/run_evolution.py and trace generators to stream candidate evaluation stats (totalCandidatesEvaluated, infeasibleCount, acceptedCount, latestStatus). 2. Add a real-time 'Candidate Exploration & Feasibility' feed badge in rch/index.html to display total candidates explored, accepted improvements, and infeasibility metrics dynamically.

description: the difference beween baseline and alpha evolve in the Dynamic Live run is fewer surgeries, more fatigue violations.
cause: In traces_dynamic.jsonl, mutated program steps increase total surgeries scheduled from 122 to 126 (+4), but also increase shift fatigue violations from 15 to 18 due to aggressive packing without fatigue penalties in the candidate objective function.
plan: Update traces_dynamic.jsonl and experiment/program.py mutation rules to apply a fatigue penalty term in evaluate_schedule, so that evolved candidates simultaneously increase patient throughput AND reduce fatigue violations.

description: the Simulate OT Disruption serves no purpose since the OT Disruption is hard coded into the scenario. Either remove the button, or enable the disruption to be randomly placed
cause: Clicking Simulate OT Disruption appends a fixed OT_2 Tuesday 10:00-14:00 maintenance block into EVOLUTION_DATA.unavailability, which is already hardcoded in the scenario configuration.
plan: Enable dynamic random placement of OT disruptions (pick a random available OT room, active day, and time window) or dynamically re-trigger schedule re-routing upon click.

description: the Simulate Emergency Arrival button should trigger a re-assignment of surgeries
cause: btnInjectEr manually unshifts an emergency appointment dict into currentSched without running a heuristic dynamic re-assignment function to shift bumped routine surgeries to alternate rooms/times.
plan: Implement a lightweight client-side re-assignment pass when Simulate Emergency Arrival is clicked to resolve room overlaps by moving bumped routine surgeries into open slots.

description: when I select a new scenario, swap back to the Baseline view

plan: Update the change listener for #scenario-select to set isEvolvedMode = false, remove active class from toggle-evolved, add active class to toggle-baseline, and render Baseline step 0.

tag with text '(Showing: Monday)'.

description: Repeated server log messages add little value: continuous GET /data/config.json 200 log spam in server stdout every 1-2 seconds.
cause: server.py inherits default log_message in SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, which prints a log line for every 1-2s polling request to /data/config.json and trace jsonl files.
plan: Override log_message in server.py request handler to suppress or filter out repetitive GET requests for /data/config.json and trace jsonl files unless status code is an error (>=400).

description: maintenance is not aligned correctly: Maintenance - Room Closed (10:00-14:00) block position does not align accurately with the timeline grid hour columns.
cause: Calculation of left percentage for .unavailability-block in Gantt rendering uses parseTimeToMinutes(startTime) without applying the timeline start offset (START_MINUTES = 8*60 = 480) or grid header offset alignment.
plan: Fix positioning formula in Gantt block rendering: left = ((startMins - START_MINUTES) / TOTAL_MINUTES) * 100% and width = (durationMins / TOTAL_MINUTES) * 100% so unavailability overlays align precisely under grid hour headers.

plan: Add white-space: nowrap; and flex-shrink: 0; to #scenario-hint and adjust container flex styling so the hint renders inline horizontally on one line.
